_help: Edit this file to control stats-card.svg. A tile with "source" is filled from your GitHub data; a tile with "value" is yours to type. Sources: current_streak, longest_streak, contributions, active_days, best_day, avg_active_day. You can mix both: add "value" / "unit" / "caption" / "label" to any tile to override that part. Tiles can be added or removed (2-8). Set chart.show to false to hide the bar chart; set chart.mode to "manual" and fill labels + values to type your own bars.
